title: Who is responsible when an AI agent makes a bad decision?
content_snippet:
AI agents are getting better at making decisions and taking actions on their own.

But when an agent sends the wrong email, changes the wrong data, or triggers something it shouldn't, who's responsible?

The developer? The company? Or the person supervising it?

The more autonomy we give them, the more important accountability becomes.

submitted by /u/KKevinja
title_zh: AI代理做出错误决策时，谁该负责？
summary_zh: Reddit上的一场讨论探讨了AI代理自主决策出错时的责任归属问题。随着AI代理能力增强，错误发送邮件、更改数据等风险上升，责任应归于开发者、部署公司还是监督者尚无定论。
key_points: AI代理自主决策出错的责任归属存在争议
讨论涉及开发者、公司或监督者等多方责任
问题源于AI代理日益增强的自主行动能力

title: towards never having to manually select a model again
content_snippet:
towards never having to manually select a model again

eric provencher (@pvncher)

This went under the radar this week, but we just shipped the ability for models with multi agents v2 to delegate to any supported model, including Luna!

Took a bit of time to make sure this worked reliably

title_zh: 迈向无需手动选择模型的时代
summary_zh: OpenAI联合创始人Greg Brockman转发消息，称其多智能体系统已能自动将任务委托给最合适的模型，包括Luna，旨在实现零手动选择模型。
key_points: OpenAI多智能体系统可自动委托任务给最佳模型
该系统已支持委托给任何模型，包括Luna
目标是实现完全无需手动选择模型的未来
